units.zh: 霍彥威，字子重，洺州曲周人也。
units.en: Huo Yanwei, courtesy name Zizhong, came from Quzhou in Ming Prefecture.
units.literal: Huo Yanwei, whose courtesy name was Zizhong, was a native of Quzhou in Ming Prefecture.

units.zh: 梁將霍存得之於村落間，年十四，從征討。
units.en: The Liang general Huo Cun found him in the countryside when he was fourteen, and the boy followed him on campaign.
units.literal: The Liang general Huo Cun obtained him in a village; he was fourteen and followed on campaigns.

units.zh: 存憐其爽邁，養為己子。
units.en: Cun took a liking to his spirited bearing and adopted him as his son.
units.literal: Cun pitied his bold and open manner and raised him as his own son.

units.zh: 存，梁史有傳。
units.en: Cun has a biography in the history of Liang.
units.literal: Cun has a biography in the Liang history.

units.zh: 彥威未弱冠，為梁祖所知，擢在左右，漸升戎秩，亟立戰功。
units.en: Before Yanwei came of age, the Liang Founder noticed him and kept him at his side; he rose steadily through the ranks and won distinction again and again in battle.
units.literal: Before Yanwei had reached twenty, the Liang Founder took notice of him, promoted him to his side, and he gradually rose in military rank, repeatedly earning battle merit.

units.zh: 嘗中流矢，眇其一目。
units.en: He was once hit by a stray arrow and lost the use of one eye.
units.literal: He once was struck by a stray arrow and lost sight in one eye.

units.zh: 開平二年，自開封府押衙、右親從指揮使、檢校司空授右龍驤軍使。
units.en: In the second year of Kaiping he was made commander of the Right Dragon-Soaring Army, having served as Kaifeng escort officer, commander of the right close attendants, and acting Minister of Works.
units.literal: In the second year of Kaiping, from Kaifeng Prefecture Escort Officer, Right Close Attendant Commander, and Acting Minister of Works he was appointed Right Dragon-Soaring Army Commander.

units.zh: 三年，自右監門衛將軍授左天武軍使，遷右監門上將軍。
units.en: The next year he moved from Right Gate Guard general to commander of the Left Heavenly Martial Army, then was promoted to senior general of the Right Gate Guard.
units.literal: In the third year, from Right Gate Guard General he was appointed Left Heavenly Martial Army Commander and was transferred to Right Gate Guard Senior General.

units.zh: 乾化三年，與袁象先同誅朱友珪，梁末帝授洺州刺史，轉河陽留後。
units.en: In the third year of Qianhua he joined Yuan Xiangxian in killing Zhu Yougui; the Last Liang Emperor made him prefect of Ming, then regent of Heyang.
units.literal: In the third year of Qianhua, together with Yuan Xiangxian he killed Zhu Yougui; the Last Liang Emperor appointed him prefect of Ming Prefecture and then transferred him to regent of Heyang.

units.zh: 乾化末，邠州留後李保衡背李茂貞以城歸梁，梁以彥威為邠州節度使。
units.en: Late in Qianhua, Li Baoheng, regent of Bin, broke with Li Maozhen and surrendered the city to Liang, which appointed Yanwei military governor of Bin.
units.literal: At the end of Qianhua, Binzhou regent Li Baoheng turned from Li Maozhen and surrendered the city to Liang; Liang made Yanwei military governor of Bin.

units.zh: 其年五月，茂貞遣將劉知俊率大軍攻之，彥威固守逾年，竟不能下；
units.en: That May, Maozhen sent General Liu Zhijun with a large army to attack, but Yanwei held out for more than a year and the city could not be taken;
units.literal: In the fifth month of that year, Maozhen sent the general Liu Zhijun at the head of a great army to attack; Yanwei held firm for more than a year, and in the end they could not take it;

units.zh: 或得其俘，悉令放之，秦人懷其惠，遂無侵擾。
units.en: Whenever he took prisoners he set them all free; the people of Qin were grateful for his kindness, and raids ceased.
units.literal: Whenever he captured prisoners, he ordered them all released; the people of Qin remembered his kindness, and thereafter there was no harassment.

units.zh: 轉滑州節度使。
units.en: He was transferred to military governor of Hua.
units.literal: He was transferred to military governor of Hua Prefecture.

units.zh: 移鎮鄆州，兼北面行營招討，總大軍於河上。
units.en: He was reassigned to Yun and made northern campaign pacification commissioner, taking overall command of the army on the Yellow River.
units.literal: He was moved to garrison Yun and concurrently made northern campaign pacification commissioner, commanding the great army on the Yellow River.

units.zh: 師徒屢敗，降授陝州留後。
units.en: After repeated defeats he was demoted to regent of Shan.
units.literal: His army suffered repeated defeats, and he was demoted and appointed regent of Shan Prefecture.

units.zh: 莊宗入汴，彥威自陝馳至請罪，詔釋之。
units.en: When Emperor Zhuangzong entered Bian, Yanwei rode in from Shan to surrender and beg pardon, and an edict absolved him.
units.literal: When Emperor Zhuangzong entered Bian, Yanwei galloped from Shan to submit himself and beg forgiveness; an edict pardoned him.

units.zh: 一日，莊宗於崇元殿宴諸將，彥威與段凝、袁象先等預會。
units.en: One day Emperor Zhuangzong entertained his generals in the Chongyuan Hall; Yanwei was there with Duan Ning, Yuan Xiangxian, and others.
units.literal: One day Emperor Zhuangzong held a banquet for the generals in the Chongyuan Hall; Yanwei, together with Duan Ning, Yuan Xiangxian, and others, was present.

units.zh: 酒酣，莊宗舉酒屬明宗曰：「 此席宴客，皆吾前歲之勁敵也，一旦與吾同宴，蓋卿前鋒之效也。」
units.en: As the wine flowed, Emperor Zhuangzong raised his cup to Emperor Mingzong and said, "Every guest at this table was a formidable enemy of mine only a year ago. That they now sit and feast with me is surely thanks to your work on the front lines."
units.literal: When the wine had gone deep, Emperor Zhuangzong raised his cup and addressed Emperor Mingzong, saying: "The guests at this banquet were all my fierce enemies of recent years; that they now feast with me at once is surely the effect of your vanguard work."

units.zh: 彥威等伏陛謝罪，莊宗曰：「與卿話舊，無足畏也。」
units.en: Yanwei and the others prostrated themselves on the steps to beg forgiveness. Emperor Zhuangzong said, "We are only talking over old times; there is nothing to fear."
units.literal: Yanwei and the others prostrated themselves on the steps to beg forgiveness; Emperor Zhuangzong said: "I am merely reminiscing with you; there is nothing to fear."

units.zh: 因賜禦衣、器幣，盡歡而罷。
units.en: He then gave them imperial robes and gifts, and they drank until all were satisfied before the feast broke up.
units.literal: He then bestowed imperial robes and ritual gifts, and they drank their fill before the banquet ended.

units.zh: 尋放歸藩。
units.en: Before long he was permitted to return to his post.
units.literal: Soon afterward he was allowed to return to his fief.

units.zh: 明年，從明宗平潞州，授徐州節度使。
units.en: The following year he followed Emperor Mingzong in pacifying Luzhou and was made military governor of Xu.
units.literal: The next year, following Emperor Mingzong in pacifying Luzhou, he was appointed military governor of Xu Prefecture.

units.zh: 契丹犯塞，莊宗以明宗為北面招討使，命彥威為副。
units.en: When the Khitan raided the border, Emperor Zhuangzong appointed Emperor Mingzong northern pacification commissioner and made Yanwei his deputy.
units.literal: When the Khitan raided the frontier, Emperor Zhuangzong made Emperor Mingzong northern pacification commissioner and ordered Yanwei as his deputy.

units.zh: 彥威善言論，頗能接奉，明宗尤重之。
units.en: Yanwei was an engaging speaker and knew how to win people over; Emperor Mingzong held him in particular esteem.
units.literal: Yanwei was skilled in discourse and quite able in attending and serving; Emperor Mingzong especially valued him.

units.zh: 趙太叛於邢州，奉詔討平之。
units.en: When Zhao Tai rebelled at Xing, he received orders to put down the revolt.
units.literal: Zhao Tai rebelled at Xing Prefecture; by imperial order he was sent to suppress and pacify him.

units.zh: 時趙在禮據魏州，與明宗會兵於鄴下，大軍夕亂，明宗為其所逼，彥威從入魏州。
units.en: Zhao Zaili then held Wei; he and Emperor Mingzong joined forces below Ye, but at nightfall the army mutinied and forced Emperor Mingzong in, with Yanwei following him into the city.
units.literal: At that time Zhao Zaili held Wei Prefecture; he joined forces with Emperor Mingzong below Ye, and at evening the great army fell into disorder; Emperor Mingzong was pressed by them, and Yanwei followed him into Wei.

units.zh: 皇甫暉等尤忌彥威，欲殺之，彥威機辯開說，竟免。
units.en: Huangfu Hui and his men especially hated Yanwei and wanted him dead, but Yanwei talked his way out of it with quick wit and was spared.
units.literal: Huangfu Hui and the others especially resented Yanwei and wished to kill him; Yanwei, quick-witted and eloquent, argued and persuaded them, and in the end he escaped.

units.zh: 及出，彥威部下兵士獨全，衛護明宗至魏縣。
units.en: When they left the city, Yanwei alone kept his troops intact and escorted Emperor Mingzong to Wei County.
units.literal: When they came out, only Yanwei's troops remained intact; they escorted Emperor Mingzong as far as Wei County.

units.zh: 時明宗欲北趨常山，彥威與安重誨懇請赴闕。
units.en: Emperor Mingzong then wanted to flee north toward Changshan, but Yanwei and An Chonghui urgently persuaded him to go to the capital instead.
units.literal: At that time Emperor Mingzong wished to hurry north toward Changshan; Yanwei and An Chonghui earnestly urged him to go to the capital.

units.zh: 從至洛陽，彥威首率卿相勸進於至德宮。
units.en: He followed to Luoyang, where Yanwei was first among the ministers to urge his accession at the Zhide Palace.
units.literal: He followed to Luoyang, and Yanwei was the first to lead the ministers and grandees in urging accession at the Zhide Palace.

units.zh: 旬日之間，內外機事，皆決於彥威。
units.en: Within ten days every matter of state, at home and abroad, was decided by Yanwei.
units.literal: Within ten days, all internal and external affairs of state were decided by Yanwei.

units.zh: 擅收段凝、溫韜下獄，將置於法。
units.en: He took it upon himself to arrest Duan Ning and Wen Tao and throw them in prison, intending to have them executed.
units.literal: On his own authority he seized Duan Ning and Wen Tao and put them in prison, intending to punish them by law.

units.zh: 安重誨曰：「溫、段罪惡，負於梁室，眾所知矣。
units.en: An Chonghui said, "Wen and Duan are guilty men who betrayed the house of Liang, as everyone knows.
units.literal: An Chonghui said: "Wen and Duan are guilty and have wronged the house of Liang; this is known to all.

units.zh: 今主上克平內艱，冀安萬國，豈為公報仇耶！」
units.en: Our lord has just overcome internal crisis and hopes to bring peace to the realm. Surely he is not settling your private score!"
units.literal: Now our lord has overcome internal troubles and hopes to settle the realm; would he settle your private score of vengeance!"

units.zh: 至天成初，除鄆州節度使。
units.en: At the start of Tiancheng he was made military governor of Yun.
units.literal: At the beginning of Tiancheng he was appointed military governor of Yun Prefecture.

units.zh: 值青州王公儼拒命，改平盧軍節度，至鎮，擒公儼，斬之。
units.en: When Wang Gongyan of Qing defied orders, he was reassigned as military governor of Pinglu; on reaching his post he captured Gongyan and executed him.
units.literal: When Wang Gongyan of Qing Prefecture defied orders, he was changed to military governor of the Pinglu Army; upon reaching his post he captured Gongyan and beheaded him.

units.zh: 明年冬，賜覲於汴州，明宗接遇甚厚，累官至檢校太尉、兼中書令。
units.en: The following winter he was granted an audience at Bian, where Emperor Mingzong received him with great warmth; he rose to acting Grand Commandant and concurrent Director of the Secretariat.
units.literal: The next winter he was granted an audience at Bian; Emperor Mingzong received him with great favor, and he rose in office to Acting Grand Commandant and concurrent Director of the Secretariat.

units.zh: 三年冬，卒於理所，年五十七。
units.en: In the third winter he died at his headquarters, at the age of fifty-seven.
units.literal: In the third winter he died at his headquarters, aged fifty-seven.

units.zh: 奏至之日，明宗方出近郊。
units.en: When the memorial arrived, Emperor Mingzong was away on an outing in the suburbs.
units.literal: On the day the memorial arrived, Emperor Mingzong had just gone out to the near suburbs.

units.zh: 忽聞奏訃，掩泣歸宮，輟朝三日，至月終不舉樂。
units.en: On hearing the news of his death he wept and returned to the palace, suspended court for three days, and forbade music for the rest of the month.
units.literal: Suddenly hearing the memorial of death, he covered his face and wept as he returned to the palace; he suspended court for three days and until the month's end did not hold music.

units.zh: 〈（《五代會要》：天成四年六月敕：「故平盧軍節度使霍彥威，勳名顯著，宅兆已營，度遵定諡之規，俾議送終之制，宜以三公禮葬。」）〉
units.en: (Institutional History of the Five Dynasties: An edict of the sixth month of the fourth year of Tiancheng: "The late military governor of Pinglu, Huo Yanwei, whose merit and fame were outstanding, already has his tomb prepared. In keeping with the regulations for fixing posthumous titles, let the rites for his funeral be determined; he should be buried with the honors due a Three Dukes.")〉
units.literal: (Institutional History of the Five Dynasties: An edict of the sixth month of the fourth year of Tiancheng: "The late military governor of the Pinglu Army, Huo Yanwei, whose merit and fame were outstanding, has already had his tomb prepared; in accordance with the regulations for fixing posthumous titles, let the rites for seeing him to the end be discussed; he should be buried with the rites due a Three Dukes.")〉

units.zh: 冊贈太師、晉國公，諡曰忠武。
units.en: He was posthumously enfeoffed as Grand Preceptor and Duke of Jin, with the posthumous title Loyal and Martial.
units.literal: By patent he was posthumously enfeoffed as Grand Preceptor and Duke of Jin, with the posthumous title Loyal and Martial.

units.zh: 子承訓，弟彥珂，累曆刺史。
units.en: His son Chengxun and his younger brother Yanke both served terms as prefect.
units.literal: His son Chengxun and his younger brother Yanke both served in succession as prefects.

units.zh: 皇朝乾德中，立明宗廟於洛州，詔以彥威配饗廟庭。
units.en: In the Qiande era of our dynasty, when Emperor Mingzong's temple was established at Luo, an edict made Yanwei a co-honoree in the temple rites.
units.literal: In the Qiande era of the Imperial Dynasty, when Emperor Mingzong's temple was established at Luo Prefecture, an edict ordered Yanwei to share in the offerings in the temple court.

units.zh: 王晏球，字瑩之，自言洛都人。
units.en: Wang Yanqiu, courtesy name Yingzhi, claimed Luoyang as his home.
units.literal: Wang Yanqiu, whose courtesy name was Yingzhi, said of himself that he was a man of the Luoyang capital.

units.zh: 少遇亂，為蔡賊所掠，汴人杜氏畜之為子，因冒姓杜氏。
units.en: As a boy he was caught up in the chaos and seized by Cai bandits; a Bian man surnamed Du adopted him, and he took the Du surname.
units.literal: In youth he met with disorder and was seized by Cai bandits; a man of Bian named Du took him in as a son, and he therefore falsely took the surname Du.

units.zh: 晏球少沉勇有斷，倜儻不群。
units.en: As a youth Yanqiu was steady, brave, and decisive, with a bold and unconventional bearing.
units.literal: Yanqiu in youth was deep, brave, and decisive, free-spirited and standing apart from the crowd.

units.zh: 梁祖之鎮汴也，選富家子有材力者，置之帳下，號曰「廳子都」。
units.en: When the Liang Founder held Bian, he picked strong and capable sons of wealthy families for his personal retinue and called them the "Hall Sons Corps."
units.literal: When the Liang Founder held Bian as his base, he selected sons of wealthy families with talent and strength, placed them under his command, and called them the "Hall Sons Corps."

units.zh: 〈（《清異錄》：宣武廳子都，尤勇悍，其弩張一大機，則十二小機皆發，用連珠大箭，無遠不及，晉人極畏此。）〉
units.en: (Records of Unusual Distinctions: The Xuanwu Hall Sons Corps were especially fierce. When their crossbow drew one main mechanism, twelve smaller ones fired together, shooting great linked-bead arrows that struck at any range; the men of Jin feared them above all.)〉
units.literal: (Records of Unusual Distinctions: The Xuanwu Hall Sons Corps were especially fierce and bold; when their crossbow drew one great mechanism, then twelve small mechanisms all released, using linked-bead great arrows; nothing at a distance was beyond reach, and the men of Jin greatly feared this.)〉

units.zh: 晏球預選，從梁祖征伐，所至立功，累遷廳子都指揮使。
units.en: Yanqiu was selected for the corps and followed the Liang Founder on campaign, winning distinction wherever he fought until he rose to command the Hall Sons Corps.
units.literal: Yanqiu was chosen in the selection; he followed the Liang Founder on campaigns, earned merit wherever he went, and was repeatedly promoted to commander of the Hall Sons Corps.

units.zh: 梁開平三年，自開封府押衙充直左耀武指揮使，授右千牛衛將軍，軍職如故。
units.en: In the third year of Liang Kaiping he was made acting commander of the Left Dazzling Martial Guard and Right Thousand-Ox Guard general, while retaining his army command.
units.literal: In the third year of Liang Kaiping, from Kaifeng Prefecture Escort Officer he served as acting Left Dazzling Martial Commander and was appointed Right Thousand-Ox Guard General, his army post remaining as before.

units.zh: 朱友珪之篡位也，懷州龍驤守禦軍作亂，欲入京城。
units.en: When Zhu Yougui seized the throne, the Dragon-Soaring garrison at Huai mutinied and tried to march on the capital.
units.literal: When Zhu Yougui usurped the throne, the Huai Prefecture Dragon-Soaring Garrison Defense Army mutinied and wished to enter the capital.

units.zh: 已至河陽，友珪命晏球出騎迎戰擊亂軍，獲軍使劉重遇，以功轉左龍驤第一指揮使。
units.en: They had reached Heyang when Yougui sent Yanqiu out with cavalry to meet the rebels; he captured the mutiny leader Liu Chongyu and was promoted to first commander of the Left Dragon-Soaring Army.
units.literal: They had already reached Heyang; Yougui ordered Yanqiu to lead cavalry out to meet and strike the mutinous army, captured army commander Liu Chongyu, and for his merit was transferred to First Commander of the Left Dragon-Soaring Army.

units.zh: 梁末帝嗣位，以晏球為龍驤四軍都指揮使。
units.en: When the Last Liang Emperor took the throne, he made Yanqiu overall commander of the four Dragon-Soaring armies.
units.literal: When the Last Liang Emperor succeeded to the throne, he made Yanqiu overall commander of the four Dragon-Soaring armies.

units.zh: 貞明二年四月十九日夜，汴州捉生都將李霸等作亂，縱火焚剽，攻建國門，梁末帝登樓拒戰。
units.en: On the night of the nineteenth day of the fourth month of the second year of Zhenming, Li Ba and other commanders of the Bianzhou foraging corps mutinied, setting fires and looting as they attacked the Jianguo Gate; the Last Liang Emperor mounted the tower to fight them off.
units.literal: On the night of the nineteenth day of the fourth month of the second year of Zhenming, Li Ba and others, commanders of the Bianzhou Foraging Corps, mutinied, set fires and looted, attacked the Jianguo Gate, and the Last Liang Emperor mounted the tower to resist.

units.zh: 晏球聞亂，先得龍驤馬五百屯於鞠場，俄而亂兵以竿豎麻布沃油焚建國縷，勢將危急。
units.en: Hearing of the mutiny, Yanqiu first gathered five hundred Dragon-Soaring cavalrymen at the drill ground; soon the rebels raised poles draped with oil-soaked cloth to set the Jianguo gate tower ablaze, and the situation grew desperate.
units.literal: Yanqiu heard of the disorder and first gathered five hundred Dragon-Soaring cavalrymen and encamped them at the drill ground; soon the mutinous soldiers raised poles with hemp cloth soaked in oil to burn the Jianguo gate tower, and the situation was about to become critical.

units.zh: 晏球隔門窺亂兵，見無甲胄，即出騎擊之，奮力血戰，俄而群賊散走。
units.en: Yanqiu looked through the gate at the rebels, saw they wore no armor, and led his cavalry out to attack; after a fierce fight the rebels broke and fled.
units.literal: Yanqiu peered through the gate at the mutinous soldiers, saw they wore no armor, and immediately led cavalry out to strike them; fighting fiercely in bloody combat, before long the band of rebels scattered and fled.

units.zh: 梁末帝見騎軍討賊，呼曰：「非吾龍驤之士乎？」
units.en: The Last Liang Emperor saw the cavalry fighting the rebels and called out, "Are those not my Dragon-Soaring men?"
units.literal: The Last Liang Emperor saw the cavalry suppressing the rebels and called out: "Are these not my Dragon-Soaring men?"

units.zh: 晏球奏曰：「亂者惟李霸一都，陛下但守宮城，遲明臣必破之。」
units.en: Yanqiu reported, "The rebels are only Li Ba's one corps. Your Majesty need only hold the palace; by dawn I will destroy them."
units.literal: Yanqiu reported: "The mutineers are only Li Ba's one corps; Your Majesty need only hold the palace city, and by dawn your subject will surely break them."

units.zh: 既而晏球盡戮亂軍，全營族誅，以功授單州刺史。
units.en: Before long Yanqiu slaughtered the mutineers and executed their entire camp by clan punishment; for this he was made prefect of Shan.
units.literal: Before long Yanqiu slaughtered all the mutinous soldiers and executed the entire camp by clan punishment; for his merit he was appointed prefect of Shan Prefecture.

units.zh: 尋領軍於河上，為行營馬軍都指揮兼諸軍排陣使。
units.en: Soon he took command on the Yellow River as overall cavalry commander of the campaign headquarters and marshal of battle formations for all armies.
units.literal: Soon afterward he led the army on the Yellow River as overall cavalry commander of the campaign headquarters and concurrently array marshal for all armies.

units.zh: 莊宗入汴，晏球率騎軍入援。
units.en: When Emperor Zhuangzong entered Bian, Yanqiu led his cavalry in to reinforce the city.
units.literal: When Emperor Zhuangzong entered Bian, Yanqiu led the cavalry army in to reinforce.

units.zh: 至封丘，聞梁末帝殂，即解甲降於莊宗。
units.en: At Fengqiu he learned that the Last Liang Emperor was dead and at once laid down his arms and surrendered to Emperor Zhuangzong.
units.literal: When he reached Fengqiu and heard that the Last Liang Emperor had died, he immediately laid down his armor and surrendered to Emperor Zhuangzong.

units.zh: 明年，與霍彥威北捍契丹，授齊州防禦使、北面行營馬軍都指揮使，仍賜姓氏，名紹虔。
units.en: The following year he joined Huo Yanwei in defending the north against the Khitan and was made defense commissioner of Qi and cavalry commander of the northern campaign; he was also granted the imperial surname and the name Shaoqian.
units.literal: The next year, together with Huo Yanwei he defended the north against the Khitan; he was appointed defense commissioner of Qi Prefecture and cavalry commander of the northern campaign headquarters, and was also granted the imperial surname with the name Shaoqian.

units.zh: 鄴之亂，明宗入赴內難，晏球時在瓦橋，遣人招之。
units.en: During the Ye mutiny, Emperor Mingzong marched to answer the crisis; Yanqiu was at Waqiao and sent men to summon him.
units.literal: During the disorder at Ye, Emperor Mingzong entered to answer the internal crisis; Yanqiu was then at Waqiao and sent men to summon him.

units.zh: 明宗至汴，晏球率騎從至京師，以平定功授宋州節度使，上章求還本姓名。
units.en: When Emperor Mingzong reached Bian, Yanqiu followed with his cavalry to the capital; for his role in the pacification he was made military governor of Song and petitioned to restore his original name.
units.literal: When Emperor Mingzong reached Bian, Yanqiu led cavalry and followed to the capital; for his merit in pacification he was appointed military governor of Song Prefecture and submitted a memorial asking to restore his original surname and given name.

units.zh: 天成二年，授北面行營副招討，以兵戍滿城。
units.en: In the second year of Tiancheng he was made deputy northern pacification commissioner and garrisoned Mancheng.
units.literal: In the second year of Tiancheng he was appointed deputy northern pacification commissioner and garrisoned Mancheng with troops.

units.zh: 是歲，王都據定州，
units.en: That year Wang Du held Ding,
units.literal: That year Wang Du held Ding Prefecture,

units.zh: 〈（《通鑒》：遣人說北面副招討使王晏球，晏球不從，乃以金遺晏球帳下，使圖之，不克。
units.en: (Comprehensive Mirror: He sent men to win over the deputy northern pacification commissioner Wang Yanqiu, but Yanqiu refused; he then bribed men in Yanqiu's camp to plot against him, without success.
units.literal: (Comprehensive Mirror: He sent men to persuade the deputy northern pacification commissioner Wang Yanqiu; Yanqiu would not follow, so he sent gold to men under Yanqiu's command and had them plot against him, but it did not succeed.

units.zh: 癸巳，晏球以都反狀聞。
units.en: On guisi day Yanqiu reported Du's rebellion to the throne.
units.literal: On the day guisi, Yanqiu reported Du's rebellion.

units.zh: 壬寅，以王晏球為北面招討使，權知定州行州事。）〉
units.en: On renyin day Wang Yanqiu was made northern pacification commissioner and acting administrator of Ding.)〉
units.literal: On the day renyin, Wang Yanqiu was made northern pacification commissioner and acting administrator of Ding Prefecture affairs.)〉

units.zh: 契丹遣禿餒率騎千餘來援都，突入定州，晏球引軍保曲陽。
units.en: The Khitan sent Tunei with more than a thousand cavalry to aid Du; they broke into Ding, and Yanqiu withdrew his army to Quyang.
units.literal: The Khitan sent Tunei at the head of more than a thousand cavalry to aid Du; they burst into Ding Prefecture, and Yanqiu led his army to hold Quyang.

units.zh: 王都、托諾出軍拒戰，晏球督厲軍士，令短兵擊賊，戒之曰：「回首者死。」
units.en: Wang Du and Tuonuo marched out to fight; Yanqiu roused his men for close combat and warned them, "Turn back and you die."
units.literal: Wang Du and Tuonuo led troops out to resist; Yanqiu urged and roused his soldiers, ordered close combat against the enemy, and warned them: "Whoever turns back dies."

units.zh: 符彥卿以龍武左軍攻軍其左，高行周以龍武右軍攻其右，奮劍揮楇，應手首落，賊軍大敗於嘉山之下，追襲至於城門。
units.en: Fu Yanqing's Left Dragon Martial Army struck their left flank and Gao Xingzhou's Right Dragon Martial Army their right; swords and clubs flashed and heads fell at every stroke. The enemy was routed below Jia Mountain and pursued to the city gates.
units.literal: Fu Yanqing with the Left Dragon Martial Army attacked their left, Gao Xingzhou with the Right Dragon Martial Army attacked their right; swinging swords and clubs, heads fell at every blow; the enemy army was greatly defeated below Jia Mountain, and the pursuit reached the city gate.

units.zh: 俄而契丹首領惕隱率勇騎五千至唐河。
units.en: Soon the Khitan chieftain Tiyin arrived at Tang River with five thousand elite cavalry.
units.literal: Before long the Khitan chieftain Tiyin led five thousand brave cavalry to Tang River.

units.zh: 是時大雨，晏球出師逆戰，惕隱復敗，追至易州，河水暴漲，所在陷沒，俘獲二千騎而還。
units.en: Heavy rain was falling when Yanqiu marched out to meet him; Tiyin was defeated again and pursued to Yi, where flooding swallowed men and horses alike; Yanqiu returned with two thousand captives.
units.literal: At that time there was heavy rain; Yanqiu marched out to meet and fight, Tiyin was again defeated, and the pursuit reached Yi Prefecture; the river waters rose violently and everywhere collapsed and sank; they captured two thousand cavalry and returned.

units.zh: 惕隱以餘眾北走幽州，趙德鈞令牙將武從諫以騎邀擊。
units.en: Tiyin fled north toward You with the survivors; Zhao Dejun sent his officer Wu Congjian with cavalry to intercept him.
units.literal: Tiyin fled north to You Prefecture with the remaining force; Zhao Dejun ordered his staff general Wu Congjian to intercept with cavalry.

units.zh: 德鈞分扼諸要路，旬日之內，盡獲惕隱已下酋長七百餘人，契丹遂弱。
units.en: Dejun blocked the key routes; within ten days he captured more than seven hundred Khitan chiefs down to Tiyin himself, and Khitan power was broken.
units.literal: Dejun blocked the key routes in separate detachments; within ten days he captured in full more than seven hundred chieftains from Tiyin downward, and the Khitan were thereby weakened.

units.zh: 晏球圍城既久，帝遣使督攻城，晏球曰：「賊壘堅峻，但食三州租稅，撫恤黎民，愛養軍士彼自當魚潰。」
units.en: After a long siege the emperor sent an envoy to urge an assault; Yanqiu said, "The rebel stronghold is formidable. If we simply live off the tax grain of three prefectures, treat the people well, and care for our soldiers, the enemy will collapse on their own."
units.literal: Yanqiu had besieged the city for a long time; the Emperor sent an envoy to urge the assault on the city; Yanqiu said: "The rebel fortifications are strong and steep; if we simply consume the tax grain of three prefectures, soothe and comfort the common people, and cherish and nurture the soldiers, they will collapse of themselves like fish in a net."

units.zh: 帝然其言。
units.en: The emperor agreed.
units.literal: The Emperor approved his words.

units.zh: 晏珠能與將士同其甘苦，所得祿賜私財，盡以饗士，日具飲饌，與將校筵宴，待軍士有禮，軍中無不敬伏。
units.en: Yanqiu shared hardship and comfort with his officers and men, spending every stipend and private coin on feasts for the troops; he dined daily with his commanders and treated the rank and file with courtesy, winning the respect of the entire army.
units.literal: Yanqiu was able to share hardship and ease with officers and soldiers; all salary, rewards, and private wealth he obtained he used entirely to feast the troops; daily he prepared food and drink and held banquets with commanders; he treated the soldiers with courtesy, and in the army none failed to respect and submit.

units.zh: 其年冬，平賊。
units.en: That winter the rebels were subdued.
units.literal: That winter the rebels were pacified.

units.zh: 自初戰至於城拔，不戮一士，上下歡心，物議以為有將帥之略，以功授天平軍節度使。
units.en: From the first battle until the city fell he did not execute a single soldier; officers and men alike were content, and opinion held that he had a commander's true gift; for this he was made military governor of Tianping.
units.literal: From the first battle until the city was taken, not one soldier was executed; above and below were pleased at heart; public opinion held that he possessed the strategy of a commander; for his merit he was appointed military governor of the Tianping Army.

units.zh: 未幾，移鎮青州，就加兼中書令。
units.en: Before long he was transferred to Qing and concurrently promoted to Director of the Secretariat.
units.literal: Before long he was transferred to garrison Qing Prefecture and was concurrently promoted to Director of the Secretariat.

units.zh: 長興三年，卒於鎮，時年六十。
units.en: In the third year of Changxing he died at his post, at the age of sixty.
units.literal: In the third year of Changxing he died at his post, aged sixty.

units.zh: 贈太尉。
units.en: He was posthumously granted the title of Grand Commandant.
units.literal: He was posthumously granted the title of Grand Commandant.

units.zh: 子徹，位至懷州刺史。
units.en: His son Che rose to prefect of Huai.
units.literal: His son Che rose to the post of prefect of Huai Prefecture.

units.zh: 戴思遠，本梁之故將也。
units.en: Dai Siyuan had been a general of Liang.
units.literal: Dai Siyuan was originally an old general of Liang.

units.zh: 初事梁祖，以武幹知名。
units.en: He first served the Liang Founder and was known for his martial prowess.
units.literal: He first served the Liang Founder and was known for martial ability.

units.zh: 開平元年，自右羽林統軍加檢校司徒，出為晉州刺史。
units.en: In the first year of Kaiping he was made acting Minister of Education and sent out as prefect of Jin, having served as commander of the Right Forest Guard.
units.literal: In the first year of Kaiping, from Right Forest Guard Commander he was additionally appointed Acting Minister of Education and sent out as prefect of Jin Prefecture.

units.zh: 二年，授右監門上將軍，尋改華州防禦使。
units.en: The next year he was made senior general of the Right Gate Guard, then defense commissioner of Hua.
units.literal: In the second year he was appointed Right Gate Guard Senior General and soon changed to defense commissioner of Hua Prefecture.

units.zh: 三年，自左天武使復授右羽林統軍。
units.en: In the third year he returned to command the Right Forest Guard after serving as commander of the Left Heavenly Martial Army.
units.literal: In the third year, from Left Heavenly Martial Commander he was again appointed Right Forest Guard Commander.

units.zh: 郢王友珪篡位，授洺州團練使。
units.en: When Prince Ying Yougui usurped the throne, he was made training commissioner of Ming.
units.literal: When Prince Ying Yougui usurped the throne, he was appointed training commissioner of Ming Prefecture.

units.zh: 貞明中，為邢州留後，遷本州節度使。
units.en: During Zhenming he was regent of Xing and then military governor of the prefecture.
units.literal: During Zhenming he served as regent of Xing Prefecture and was transferred to military governor of that prefecture.

units.zh: 屬燕將張萬進殺滄州留後劉繼威，以城歸梁，末帝命思遠鎮之。
units.en: When the Yan general Zhang Wanjin killed the regent of Cang, Liu Jiwei, and surrendered the city to Liang, the Last Emperor sent Siyuan to take command there.
units.literal: When the Yan general Zhang Wanjin killed Cang Prefecture regent Liu Jiwei and surrendered the city to Liang, the Last Emperor ordered Siyuan to garrison it.

units.zh: 莊宗平定魏博，以兵臨滄、德，思遠棄鎮渡河歸汴，累遷天平軍節度使兼北面招討使，將兵與莊宗對壘。
units.en: When Emperor Zhuangzong pacified Weibo and marched on Cang and De, Siyuan abandoned his post, crossed the river, and fled to Bian; he rose to military governor of Tianping and northern pacification commissioner and led troops to face Emperor Zhuangzong in the field.
units.literal: When Emperor Zhuangzong pacified Weibo and pressed Cang and De with troops, Siyuan abandoned his post, crossed the river, and returned to Bian; he was repeatedly promoted to military governor of the Tianping Army and concurrent northern pacification commissioner, leading troops to face Emperor Zhuangzong in camp.

units.zh: 久之，莊宗討張文禮於鎮州，契丹來援，莊宗追襲契丹至幽州。
units.en: Later Emperor Zhuangzong marched against Zhang Wenli at Zhen; when the Khitan came to his aid, Emperor Zhuangzong pursued them all the way to You.
units.literal: After a long time Emperor Zhuangzong campaigned against Zhang Wenli at Zhen Prefecture; the Khitan came to aid him, and Emperor Zhuangzong pursued and struck the Khitan as far as You Prefecture.

units.zh: 思遠聞之，總兵以襲魏州，至魏店，遇明宗騎軍適至，思遠乃涉洹水，陷成安，復歸楊村寨，盡率其眾，攻德勝北城。
units.en: Hearing this, Siyuan massed troops to strike Wei; at Weidian he ran into Emperor Mingzong's cavalry arriving, so he crossed the Huan River, took Chengan, withdrew to Yangjia Village, and led his full force against the north city of Desheng.
units.literal: When Siyuan heard of this, he gathered troops to strike Wei Prefecture; reaching Weidian, he happened upon Emperor Mingzong's cavalry arriving; Siyuan then crossed the Huan River, took Chengan, returned to Yangjia Village, led out his entire force, and attacked the north city of Desheng.

units.zh: 城中危急，符存審晝夜乘城以拒之。
units.en: The city was in dire straits; Fu Cunshen mounted the walls day and night to hold them off.
units.literal: The city was in grave peril; Fu Cunshen day and night mounted the walls to resist.

units.zh: 莊宗自薊五日馳至魏州，思遠聞之解去。
units.en: Emperor Zhuangzong rode from Ji to Wei in five days; on hearing of his approach Siyuan broke off and withdrew.
units.literal: Emperor Zhuangzong galloped from Ji to Wei Prefecture in five days; when Siyuan heard of it he withdrew.

units.zh: 及明宗襲下鄆州，思遠罷軍權，降授宣化軍留後。
units.en: When Emperor Mingzong captured Yun, Siyuan lost his military command and was demoted to regent of Xuanhua.
units.literal: When Emperor Mingzong stormed and took Yun Prefecture, Siyuan was stripped of military authority and demoted to regent of the Xuanhua Army.

units.zh: 其年，莊宗入汴，思遠自鄧州入朝，復令歸鎮。
units.en: That year, when Emperor Zhuangzong entered Bian, Siyuan came to court from Deng and was sent back to his post.
units.literal: That year, when Emperor Zhuangzong entered Bian, Siyuan came to court from Deng Prefecture and was again ordered to return to his post.

units.zh: 明宗即位，移授洋州節度使。
units.en: When Emperor Mingzong took the throne, he was transferred to military governor of Yang.
units.literal: When Emperor Mingzong took the throne, he was transferred and appointed military governor of Yang Prefecture.

units.zh: 及西川俱叛，思遠以董璋故人，避嫌請代，征入朝宿衛，以年告老，授太子少保致仕。
units.en: When both Shu territories rebelled, Siyuan, an old friend of Dong Zhang, asked to be replaced to avoid suspicion; he was recalled to court for palace guard duty, then retired on grounds of age as Crown Prince Junior Mentor.
units.literal: When both parts of the West Riverland rebelled, Siyuan, being an old acquaintance of Dong Zhang, sought to avoid suspicion and asked to be replaced; he was summoned to court for palace guard duty, reported his age and retired, and was appointed Crown Prince Junior Mentor with retirement honors.

units.zh: 清泰二年八月，卒於家。
units.en: In the eighth month of the second year of Qingtai he died at home.
units.literal: In the eighth month of the second year of Qingtai he died at home.

units.zh: 朱漢賓，字績臣，亳州譙縣人也。
units.en: Zhu Hanbin, courtesy name Jichen, came from Qiao County in Bo Prefecture.
units.literal: Zhu Hanbin, whose courtesy name was Jichen, was a native of Qiao County in Bo Prefecture.

units.zh: 父元禮，始為郡將。
units.en: His father Yuanli had begun as a prefectural commander.
units.literal: His father Yuanli originally served as a prefectural commander.

units.zh: 梁太祖聞其名，擢為軍校，從龐師古渡淮，戰沒於淮南。
units.en: The Liang Founder heard of him and made him an army officer; he followed Pang Shigu across the Huai and was killed in battle in Huainan.
units.literal: The Liang Founder heard his name and promoted him to army officer; following Pang Shigu in crossing the Huai, he died in battle south of the Huai.

units.zh: 漢賓少有膂力，形神壯偉，膽氣過人。
units.en: As a youth Hanbin was immensely strong, with an imposing build and courage beyond ordinary men.
units.literal: Hanbin in youth had great physical strength; his form and spirit were robust and imposing, and his courage surpassed others.

units.zh: 梁祖以其父死王事，選置帳下，編入屬籍。
units.en: Because his father had died in imperial service, the Liang Founder took him into his personal retinue and enrolled him among his followers.
units.literal: Because his father had died in the ruler's service, the Liang Founder selected him and placed him under his command, enrolling him in the roster of followers.

units.zh: 梁祖之攻兗、鄆也，朱瑾募驍勇數百人，黥雙雁於其頰，立為「雁子都」。
units.en: When the Liang Founder attacked Yan and Yun, Zhu Jin recruited several hundred fierce warriors, tattooed twin geese on their cheeks, and formed them into the "Goose Sons Corps."
units.literal: When the Liang Founder attacked Yan and Yun, Zhu Jin recruited several hundred fierce warriors, tattooed twin geese on their cheeks, and established them as the "Goose Sons Corps."

units.zh: 梁祖聞之，亦選數百人，別為一軍，號為「落雁都」。
units.en: Hearing of this, the Liang Founder selected several hundred men of his own, formed a separate corps, and called it the "Falling Geese Corps."
units.literal: When the Liang Founder heard of this, he too selected several hundred men, formed them into a separate army, and called it the "Falling Geese Corps."

units.zh: 署漢賓為軍使，當時目為「朱落雁」。
units.en: He made Hanbin corps commander, and at the time people called him "Zhu the Falling Goose."
units.literal: He appointed Hanbin as corps commander; at the time he was known as "Zhu the Falling Goose."

units.zh: 後與諸將破蔡賊有功，天復中，授右羽林統軍。
units.en: Later he helped the other generals defeat the Cai bandits; during Tianfu he was made commander of the Right Forest Guard.
units.literal: Later, together with the other generals he had merit in defeating the Cai bandits; during Tianfu he was appointed Right Forest Guard Commander.

units.zh: 入梁，曆天威軍使、左羽林統軍，出為磁州刺史、滑宋二州留後、亳曹二州刺史、安州節度使。
units.en: Under Liang he served as commander of the Heavenly Might Army and the Left Forest Guard, then as prefect of Ci, regent of Hua and Song, prefect of Bo and Cao, and military governor of An.
units.literal: After entering Liang he served successively as Heavenly Might Army commander and Left Forest Guard Commander, and was sent out as prefect of Ci Prefecture, regent of Hua and Song, prefect of Bo and Cao, and military governor of An Prefecture.

units.zh: 莊宗至洛陽，漢賓自鎮入覲，復令還鎮。
units.en: When Emperor Zhuangzong reached Luoyang, Hanbin came from his post for an audience and was sent back.
units.literal: When Emperor Zhuangzong reached Luoyang, Hanbin came from his post to audience and was again ordered to return to his post.

units.zh: 明年，授左龍武統軍。
units.en: The following year he was made commander of the Left Dragon Martial Guard.
units.literal: The next year he was appointed Left Dragon Martial Commander.

units.zh: 莊宗嘗幸漢賓之第，漢賓妻進酒上食，奏家樂以娛之，自是漢賓頗蒙寵待。
units.en: Emperor Zhuangzong once visited Hanbin at home; Hanbin's wife served wine and food and played household music for him, and from then on Hanbin enjoyed considerable favor.
units.literal: Emperor Zhuangzong once visited Hanbin's residence; Hanbin's wife presented wine and served food and played household music to entertain him; from then on Hanbin received considerable favor.

units.zh: 同光四年正月，冀王朱友謙入朝，明宗居洛陽，以友謙故人，置酒於第。
units.en: In the first month of the fourth year of Tongguang, Prince Ji Zhu Youqian came to court; Emperor Mingzong was in Luoyang and, as an old friend of Youqian, held a banquet at his residence.
units.literal: In the first month of the fourth year of Tongguang, Prince Ji Zhu Youqian came to court; Emperor Mingzong was in Luoyang and, being an old friend of Youqian, set out wine at his residence.

units.zh: 莊宗諸弟在席，友謙坐在永王存霸之上。
units.en: Emperor Zhuangzong's younger brothers were present; Youqian was seated above Prince Yong Cunba.
units.literal: Emperor Zhuangzong's younger brothers were at the table; Youqian was seated above Prince Yong Cunba.

units.zh: 酒酣，漢賓以大觴奉友謙曰：「公雖名位高，坐於皇弟之上，非宜也。
units.en: As the wine flowed, Hanbin raised a great cup to Youqian and said, "Sir, though your rank is high, it is not fitting to sit above the emperor's brothers.
units.literal: When the wine had gone deep, Hanbin offered Youqian a great cup and said: "Sir, though your fame and rank are high, to sit above the emperor's brothers is not fitting.

units.zh: 仆與公俱在梁朝，以宗盟相厚，自公入朝，三發單函候問，略無報復，忽餘卑位，不亦甚乎！」
units.en: You and I were both in Liang and bound by clan ties; since you came to court I have sent three letters of inquiry with scarcely a reply. To treat me as beneath you—is that not going too far!"
units.literal: I and you were both in the house of Liang and were close as clansmen; since you entered court I have sent three separate letters of inquiry, with scarcely any reply; suddenly to treat me as beneath you—is this not excessive!"

units.zh: 元行欽恐其紛然，為解之方止。
units.en: Yuan Xingqin, fearing a quarrel, stepped in to smooth things over.
units.literal: Yuan Xingqin feared a quarrel would break out and mediated to settle it.

units.zh: 不數日，友謙赤族。
units.en: Within days Youqian's entire clan was exterminated.
units.literal: Within a few days Youqian's entire clan was exterminated.

units.zh: 趙在禮據魏州，元行欽率軍進討，詔漢賓權知河南府事。
units.en: When Zhao Zaili held Wei, Yuan Xingqin marched to suppress him; Hanbin was made acting administrator of Henan.
units.literal: When Zhao Zaili held Wei Prefecture, Yuan Xingqin led the army forward to suppress him; an edict made Hanbin acting administrator of Henan Prefecture affairs.

units.zh: 明宗以漢賓為右衛上將軍，樞密使安重誨方當委重，漢賓密令結托，得為婚家。
units.en: Emperor Mingzong made Hanbin senior general of the Right Guard; Palace Commissioner An Chonghui was then at the height of power, and Hanbin cultivated ties with him until their families were joined by marriage.
units.literal: Emperor Mingzong made Hanbin Right Guard Senior General; the Palace Commissioner An Chonghui was then in full trust, and Hanbin secretly had connections made and became related by marriage.

units.zh: 天成末，為潞州節度使，移鎮晉州。
units.en: Late in Tiancheng he was military governor of Lu, then was transferred to Jin.
units.literal: At the end of Tiancheng he was military governor of Lu Prefecture and was transferred to garrison Jin Prefecture.

units.zh: 重誨既誅，漢賓復為上將軍。
units.en: After Chonghui was executed, Hanbin returned to the post of senior general.
units.literal: After Chonghui was executed, Hanbin again became senior general.

units.zh: 明年秋，漢賓告老，授太子少保致仕。
units.en: The following autumn Hanbin retired on grounds of age and was made Crown Prince Junior Mentor.
units.literal: The next autumn Hanbin reported his age and retired; he was appointed Crown Prince Junior Mentor with retirement honors.

units.zh: 清泰二年六月卒，時年六十四。
units.en: He died in the sixth month of the second year of Qingtai, at the age of sixty-four.
units.literal: He died in the sixth month of the second year of Qingtai, aged sixty-four.

units.zh: 漢賓少勇健，及晚歲飲啖過人，其狀貌偉如也。
units.en: In youth Hanbin was brave and hardy; in old age he ate and drank more than most, and his bearing remained imposing.
units.literal: Hanbin in youth was brave and hardy, and in his later years his eating and drinking exceeded others; his appearance was grand and imposing.

units.zh: 凡所履曆，不聞逾法。
units.en: In every post he held, no one heard of his breaking the law.
units.literal: In all posts he held, nothing was heard of his transgressing the law.

units.zh: 梁時，嘗領軍屯魏州莘縣，適值連帥去郡，諸軍咸以利見誘，請自為留後，漢賓則斬其言者，拒而不從，聞者賞焉。
units.en: Under Liang he once garrisoned Shen County in Wei. When the circuit commander left, the troops, tempted by gain, urged him to declare himself regent; Hanbin beheaded the spokesman and refused, and those who heard commended him.
units.literal: During Liang, he once led troops stationed at Shen County in Wei Prefecture. When the circuit commander left the prefecture, all the troops, tempted by profit, urged him to make himself regent; Hanbin beheaded the one who spoke and refused to comply, and those who heard praised him.

units.zh: 在曹日，飛蝗去境，父老歌之。
units.en: While governing Cao, locusts left the borders, and the elders sang his praise.
units.literal: While in Cao, flying locusts left the borders, and the elders sang of him.

units.zh: 臨平陽遇旱，親齋潔禱龍子祠，逾日雨足，四封大稔，咸以為善政之所致也。
units.en: As prefect of Pingyang he met drought, personally fasted and prayed at the Longzi Shrine, and rain came the next day; the whole region had a great harvest, and all credited his good rule.
units.literal: Governing Pingyang he encountered drought; he personally fasted and prayed at the Longzi Shrine; the next day rain was sufficient, the four quarters had a great harvest, and all attributed it to good governance.

units.zh: 及致仕，東還亳郡，見鄉舊親戚淪沒者，有塋兆未辦，則給以棺斂；
units.en: After retirement he returned east to Bo. Seeing old kinsmen ruined, he supplied coffins where graves were still unmade;
units.literal: When he retired, he returned east to Bo commandery. Seeing old kinsmen fallen into ruin, where graves were not yet prepared he provided coffins for burial;

units.zh: 有婚嫁未畢，則助以資幣，受其惠者數百家，郡人義之。
units.en: where marriages were unfinished he helped with funds; several hundred households received his aid, and the people of the commandery praised his righteousness.
units.literal: where marriages were unfinished he helped with funds; those who received his kindness numbered several hundred households, and the people of the commandery praised his righteousness.

units.zh: 尋還洛陽，有第在懷仁裏，北限洛水，南枕通衢，層屋連甍，修木交幹，笙歌羅綺，日以自娛，養彼太和，保其餘齒，此乃近朝知止之良將也。
units.en: Soon he was back in Luoyang, with a mansion in Huairen Lane facing the Luo to the north and the main road to the south—tiered roofs, tall trees, music and brocade for daily pleasure, nurturing ease and keeping his last years; a fine general of recent times who knew when to stop.
units.literal: Soon he returned to Luoyang and had a mansion in Huairen Lane, bounded north by the Luo River and south by the main thoroughfare, with layered roofs and connected eaves, tall trees interlacing branches, singing, silk, and brocade for daily amusement, nurturing great harmony and preserving his remaining years—this was a fine general of recent times who knew when to stop.

units.zh: 晉高祖即位，贈太子少傅，諡曰貞惠。
units.en: When Jin's Gaozu took the throne, he was posthumously made Junior Mentor of the Heir with the posthumous name Zhenhui—Loyal and Kind.
units.literal: When Jin's Gaozu took the throne, he was posthumously made Junior Mentor of the Heir and given the posthumous title Zhenhui.

units.zh: 子四人，長曰崇勳，官至左武衛將軍。
units.en: He had four sons; the eldest, Chongxun, rose to general of the Left Martial Guard.
units.literal: He had four sons; the eldest was named Chongxun, who rose to Left Martial Guard General.

units.zh: 孔勍，字鼎文，兗州人，後徙家宿州。
units.en: Kong Qing, courtesy name Dingwen, came from Yan Prefecture and later moved his household to Su.
units.literal: Kong Qing, whose courtesy name was Dingwen, was from Yan Prefecture and later moved his household to Su Prefecture.

units.zh: 少便騎射，為軍中小校，事梁祖漸至郡守，累遷齊州防禦使、唐鄧節度使。
units.en: Skilled in riding and archery from youth, he served as a junior army officer under the Liang Founder, rose to prefect, and was repeatedly made defense commissioner of Qi and military commissioner of the Tang-Deng circuit.
units.literal: Skilled in horsemanship and archery in youth, he served as a junior officer in the army, followed the Liang Founder and gradually rose to prefect, and was repeatedly transferred to Defense Commissioner of Qi Prefecture and Military Commissioner of the Tang-Deng circuit.

units.zh: 梁貞明中，王球據襄州叛，討平之，因授山南東道節度使。
units.en: In Liang's Zhenming era Wang Qiu seized Xiangzhou and rebelled; Qing put him down and was made military commissioner of the Shannan East circuit.
units.literal: In Zhenming of Liang, Wang Qiu seized Xiang Prefecture and rebelled; Qing suppressed him and was accordingly made military commissioner of the Shannan East circuit.

units.zh: 莊宗至洛陽，自鎮來朝，復令歸鎮，尋移昭義節度使。
units.en: When Zhuangzong reached Luoyang, Qing came from his post to court and was sent back; soon he was transferred to military commissioner of Zhaoyi.
units.literal: When Zhuangzong reached Luoyang, Qing came from his post to audience and was again ordered to return; soon he was transferred to military commissioner of the Zhaoyi circuit.

units.zh: 同光季年，監軍楊繼源與都將謀據潞州，事泄，誅之。
units.en: Late in Tongguang, army supervisor Yang Jiyuan and a chief general plotted to seize Luzhou; when the plot leaked, Qing executed him.
units.literal: In the closing years of Tongguang, army supervisor Yang Jiyuan and a chief general plotted to seize Lu Prefecture; when the affair leaked, Qing executed him.

units.zh: 明宗即位之歲，詔還京師，授河陽節度使。
units.en: The year Mingzong took the throne, an edict recalled him to the capital and made him military commissioner of Heyang.
units.literal: In the year Mingzong took the throne, he was recalled to the capital by edict and made military commissioner of Heyang.

units.zh: 未幾，以太子太師致仕，卒年七十九。
units.en: Soon he retired as Grand Tutor of the Heir and died at seventy-nine.
units.literal: Before long he retired as Grand Tutor of the Heir and died at seventy-nine.

units.zh: 贈太尉。
units.en: The court posthumously granted him the title of Grand Commandant.
units.literal: He was posthumously granted the title of Grand Commandant.

units.zh: 劉玘，汴州雍邱人也。
units.en: Liu Qi came from Yongqiu in Bian Prefecture.
units.literal: Liu Qi was from Yongqiu in Bian Prefecture.

units.zh: 世為宣武軍牙將。
units.en: His family had served for generations as teeth generals of the Xuanwu army.
units.literal: His family for generations were teeth generals of the Xuanwu army.

units.zh: 玘少負壯節，梁祖鎮汴州，玘求自試，補隊長。
units.en: As a youth Qi had bold integrity; when the Liang Founder held Bianzhou, Qi asked to prove himself and was made squad leader.
units.literal: Qi in youth possessed bold integrity; when the Liang Founder held Bian Prefecture, Qi asked to prove himself and was appointed squad leader.

units.zh: 從梁祖征伐，所至有功，遷為牙將，曆滑、徐、襄三州都指揮使。
units.en: Following the Liang Founder on campaigns he won merit wherever he went, rose to teeth general, and served successively as chief commander of Hua, Xu, and Xiang.
units.literal: Following the Liang Founder on campaigns, wherever he went he had merit; he was promoted to teeth general and served successively as chief commander of Hua, Xu, and Xiang prefectures.

units.zh: 開平中，襄帥王班為帳下所害，亂軍推玘為留後，玘詭從之，翌日受賀，衙庭享士，伏甲幕下，盡斬其亂將。
units.en: In Kaiping the Xiang commander Wang Ban was killed by his own men; the mutineers made Qi regent, and Qi pretended to accept. The next day, at the congratulatory feast in the court hall, he hid armed men beneath the curtains and executed all the rebel leaders.
units.literal: In Kaiping, Xiang commander Wang Ban was killed by his own men; the mutinous troops pushed Qi as regent; Qi feigned consent; the next day at the congratulatory reception in the court hall he feasted the officers with armed men hidden beneath the curtains and executed all the mutinous generals.

units.zh: 以功曆復、亳二州刺史，征為侍衛都將，出為安州刺史。
units.en: For his merit he served successively as prefect of Fu and Bo, was recalled as commandant of the palace guards, and was sent out as prefect of An.
units.literal: For merit he successively served as prefect of Fu and Bo, was recalled as commandant of the palace guards, and went out as prefect of An.

units.zh: 貞明中，為晉州留後。
units.en: In Zhenming he was regent of Jin Prefecture.
units.literal: In Zhenming he was regent of Jin Prefecture.

units.zh: 莊宗至汴，玘來朝。
units.en: When Zhuangzong reached Bian, Qi came to court.
units.literal: When Zhuangzong reached Bian, Qi came to audience.

units.zh: 玘在晉州八年，日與上黨、太原之師交鬥於境上。
units.en: Qi held Jin Prefecture eight years, fighting daily on the border with forces from Shangdang and Taiyuan.
units.literal: Qi was at Jin Prefecture eight years, daily fighting on the border with forces from Shangdang and Taiyuan.

units.zh: 莊宗見而勞之曰：「劉侯無恙，控我晉陽之南鄙，歲時久矣，不早相見。」
units.en: Zhuangzong saw him and said with praise, "Marquis Liu, are you well? You have held our southern border at Jinyang for many years—why did we not meet sooner?"
units.literal: Zhuangzong saw him and comforted him, saying: "Marquis Liu, are you well? You have held our southern border at Jinyang for many years—why did we not meet sooner?"

units.zh: 玘頓首謝罪。
units.en: Qi prostrated himself and begged forgiveness.
units.literal: Qi prostrated himself and begged forgiveness.

units.zh: 復命歸鎮，正授節旄，移鎮安州。
units.en: He was ordered back to his post, formally granted the commissioner seal, and transferred to An Prefecture.
units.literal: He was again ordered to return to his post, formally granted the commissioner seal, and transferred to An Prefecture.

units.zh: 明宗即位，遷鄧州節度使。
units.en: When Mingzong took the throne, he was made military commissioner of Deng.
units.literal: When Mingzong took the throne, Qi was transferred to military commissioner of Deng Prefecture.

units.zh: 天成末，以史敬鎔代之。
units.en: Late in Tiancheng, Shi Jingrong replaced him.
units.literal: At the end of Tiancheng, Shi Jingrong replaced him.

units.zh: 玘還京師，卒。
units.en: Qi returned to the capital and died.
units.literal: Qi returned to the capital and died.

units.zh: 贈侍中。
units.en: He was posthumously honored as Palace Attendant.
units.literal: He was posthumously honored as Palace Attendant.

units.zh: 有子師道，仕皇朝，為右讚善大夫。
units.en: He had a son Shidao who served our dynasty as Right Advisor-in-Attendance.
units.literal: He had a son Shidao, who served the Imperial Dynasty as Right Advisor-in-Attendance.

units.zh: 卒。
units.en: He died.
units.literal: He died.

units.zh: 周知裕，字好問，幽州人也。
units.en: Zhou Zhiyu, courtesy name Haowen, came from You Prefecture.
units.literal: Zhou Zhiyu, whose courtesy name was Haowen, was a native of You Prefecture.

units.zh: 少事燕帥劉仁恭為騎將，表為媯州刺史。
units.en: As a youth he served the Yan commander Liu Rengong as a cavalry officer and was recommended as prefect of Gui.
units.literal: In youth he served the Yan commander Liu Rengong as a cavalry officer and was memorialized as prefect of Gui Prefecture.

units.zh: 久之，移刺德州。
units.en: Later he was transferred to prefect of De.
units.literal: After a long time he was transferred to serve as prefect of De Prefecture.

units.zh: 天祐四年，劉守光既平滄州，乃以其幼子繼威為留後，大將張萬進與知裕佐之。
units.en: In the fourth year of Tianyou, after Liu Shouguang pacified Cang, he made his youngest son Jiwei regent, with the great general Zhang Wanjin and Zhiyu to assist him.
units.literal: In the fourth year of Tianyou, after Liu Shouguang had pacified Cang Prefecture, he made his youngest son Jiwei regent, with the great general Zhang Wanjin and Zhiyu to assist him.

units.zh: 繼威衝幼，宣淫於萬進之家，萬進殺之。
units.en: Jiwei was young and headstrong and openly debauched himself in Wanjin's household; Wanjin killed him.
units.literal: Jiwei was young and rash; he openly debauched himself in Wanjin's household, and Wanjin killed him.

units.zh: 詰旦，召知裕告其故，萬進自稱留後，署知裕為景州刺史。
units.en: At dawn he summoned Zhiyu and explained what he had done; Wanjin declared himself regent and appointed Zhiyu prefect of Jing.
units.literal: At dawn he summoned Zhiyu and told him the reason; Wanjin declared himself regent and appointed Zhiyu prefect of Jing Prefecture.

units.zh: 會萬進納款於梁，知裕先奔於汴，梁主厚待之。
units.en: When Wanjin submitted to Liang, Zhiyu fled first to Bian, where the Liang ruler received him warmly.
units.literal: When Wanjin submitted to Liang, Zhiyu fled first to Bian; the Liang ruler treated him generously.

units.zh: 特置歸化軍，以知裕為指揮使。
units.en: A special Return-to-Grace Army was created with Zhiyu as its commander.
units.literal: A Return-to-Grace Army was specially established, with Zhiyu as its commander.

units.zh: 凡軍士自河朔歸梁者，皆隸於部下。
units.en: All soldiers who came over to Liang from the Hebei region were placed under his command.
units.literal: All soldiers who returned to Liang from the Hebei region were placed under his command.

units.zh: 梁與莊宗交戰於河，摧堅挫銳，惟恃歸化一軍，然歲將一紀，位不及郡守。
units.en: In Liang's battles with Emperor Zhuangzong on the Yellow River, where hardened lines were broken and elite troops blunted, they relied solely on the Return-to-Grace Army; yet after nearly twelve years his rank still fell short of a prefect.
units.literal: When Liang and Emperor Zhuangzong fought on the river, breaking hardened foes and blunting sharp attacks, they relied solely on the Return-to-Grace Army; yet nearly a full cycle of years passed and his rank did not reach that of a prefect.

units.zh: 同光初，莊宗入汴，知裕隨段凝軍解甲封丘。
units.en: Early in Tongguang, when Emperor Zhuangzong entered Bian, Zhiyu followed Duan Ning's army in surrendering at Fengqiu.
units.literal: At the beginning of Tongguang, when Emperor Zhuangzong entered Bian, Zhiyu followed Duan Ning's army in laying down arms at Fengqiu.

units.zh: 明宗時為總管，受降於郊外，見知裕甚喜，遙相謂曰：「周歸化今為吾人，何樂如之！」
units.en: Emperor Mingzong was then overall commander and received the surrender outside the city; seeing Zhiyu he was delighted and called out from afar, "Zhou of the Return-to-Grace Army is ours now—what could bring greater joy!"
units.literal: Emperor Mingzong was then overall commander and received the surrender in the suburbs; seeing Zhiyu he was greatly pleased and called out from afar: "Zhou of the Return-to-Grace Army is now one of ours—what joy could equal this!"

units.zh: 因令諸子以兄事之。
units.en: He then told his sons to treat Zhiyu as an elder brother.
units.literal: He then ordered his sons to treat him as an elder brother.

units.zh: 莊宗撫憐尤異，而諸校心妒之。
units.en: Emperor Zhuangzong showed him exceptional favor, but the other officers grew jealous.
units.literal: Emperor Zhuangzong showed him special favor and affection, but the various officers resented him in their hearts.

units.zh: 有壯士唐從益者，因獵射之，知裕遁而獲免。
units.en: A warrior named Tang Congyi shot at him while hunting; Zhiyu fled and escaped.
units.literal: There was a strong man named Tang Congyi who, while hunting, shot at him; Zhiyu fled and escaped.

units.zh: 莊宗遂誅從益，出知裕為房州刺史。
units.en: Emperor Zhuangzong executed Congyi and sent Zhiyu out as prefect of Fang.
units.literal: Emperor Zhuangzong then executed Congyi and sent Zhiyu out as prefect of Fang Prefecture.

units.zh: 魏王繼岌伐蜀，召為前鋒騎將。
units.en: When Prince Wei Jiji campaigned against Shu, he was summoned as vanguard cavalry commander.
units.literal: When Prince Wei Jiji campaigned against Shu, he was summoned as vanguard cavalry commander.

units.zh: 明宗即位，移刺絳州，改淄州刺史、宿州團練使。
units.en: When Emperor Mingzong took the throne, he was transferred to Jiang, then made prefect of Zi and training commissioner of Su.
units.literal: When Emperor Mingzong took the throne, he was transferred to serve as prefect of Jiang Prefecture, then changed to prefect of Zi Prefecture and training commissioner of Su Prefecture.

units.zh: 知裕老於軍旅，勤於稼穡，凡為郡勸課，皆有政聲，朝廷喜之，遷安州留後。
units.en: Zhiyu was a veteran of camp and field and diligent in promoting agriculture; in every prefecture he governed he won a reputation for good administration, and the court was pleased to make him regent of An.
units.literal: Zhiyu was seasoned in military affairs and diligent in farming; wherever he governed a prefecture and urged cultivation, he had a reputation for good administration; the court was pleased and transferred him to regent of An Prefecture.

units.zh: 淮上之風惡病者，至於父母有疾，不親省視，甚者避於他室；
units.en: Along the Huai there was a custom of shunning the sick; when parents fell ill their children would not visit them in person, and some even kept to another room;
units.literal: The custom along the Huai feared the sick; when parents fell ill they would not personally visit and attend them, and in extreme cases they avoided them in another room;

units.zh: 或時問訊，即以食物揭於長竿之首，委之而去。
units.en: when they did inquire, they would tie food to the end of a long pole, leave it, and go away.
units.literal: when they occasionally inquired after them, they would attach food to the end of a long pole, leave it, and go away.

units.zh: 知裕心惡之，召鄉之頑很者訶詰教導，俾知父子骨肉之恩，由是弊風稍革。
units.en: Zhiyu abhorred this practice; he summoned the most stubborn men of the district, rebuked and instructed them in the bonds of family, and gradually reformed the custom.
units.literal: Zhiyu detested this in his heart; he summoned the stubborn and harsh men of the district, rebuked and instructed them, and made them understand the bond of father and son and flesh and bone; thereby the corrupt custom was gradually reformed.

units.zh: 長興末，入為右神武統軍。
units.en: Late in Changxing he was recalled to court as commander of the Right Divine Martial Guard.
units.literal: At the end of Changxing he entered court as Right Divine Martial Commander.

units.zh: 清泰初，卒於官。
units.en: Early in Qingtai he died in office.
units.literal: At the beginning of Qingtai he died in office.

units.zh: 贈太傅。
units.en: He was posthumously granted the title of Grand Tutor.
units.literal: He was posthumously granted the title of Grand Tutor.

units.zh: 史臣曰：夫才之良者，在秦亦良也，在虞亦良也。
units.en: The historian writes: True talent shines wherever it serves—in Qin or in Yu alike.
units.literal: The historian says: A man of fine talent is fine in Qin and fine in Yu as well.

units.zh: 故彥威而下，昔為梁臣，不虧亮節；
units.en: From Yanwei downward, though they had once served Liang, they never compromised their integrity;
units.literal: Thus from Yanwei downward, though they were once ministers of Liang, they did not compromise their bright integrity;

units.zh: 洎歸唐祚，亦無醜聲，蓋鬆貞不變於四時，玉粹寧虞其烈焰故也。
units.en: and when they entered Tang's service they bore no stain on their names—for the pine keeps its constancy through every season, and pure jade does not fear the flame.
units.literal: and when they returned to the fortune of Tang they likewise had no disgraceful reputation—for the pine keeps its constancy through the four seasons, and pure jade need not fear blazing fire.

units.zh: 況彥威之輔明宗也，有翊戴之績；
units.en: Moreover, Yanwei had the achievement of supporting Emperor Mingzong's accession;
units.literal: Moreover, in aiding Emperor Mingzong, Yanwei had the achievement of supporting his accession;

units.zh: 晏球之伐中山也，著戡定之功。
units.en: and Yanqiu won distinction in pacifying Zhongshan.
units.literal: and in campaigning against Zhongshan, Yanqiu displayed the merit of pacification and settlement.

units.zh: 方之數公，尤為優矣。
units.en: Among these men, they stood out above the rest.
units.literal: Compared with the several others, they were especially outstanding.

units.zh: 〈（《琬琰集》載《宋實錄·王全斌傳》云：同光末，蕭牆有變，亂兵逼宮城，近臣宿將，皆釋甲潛遁，惟全斌與符彥卿等十數人居中拒戰。
units.en: (The 《Collected Writings》 cites the 《Song Veritable Records · Wang Quanbin Biography》: at the end of Tongguang, palace mutiny drove rebels against the capital; close ministers and veteran generals shed armor and fled; only Quanbin, Fu Yanqing, and a dozen others held the center to fight.
units.literal: (The 《Collected Writings》 records the 《Song Veritable Records · Wang Quanbin Biography》 as saying: at the end of Tongguang, turmoil rose within the palace walls; rebel troops pressed the palace city; close ministers and veteran generals all doffed armor and fled in secret; only Quanbin and Fu Yanqing and more than ten others held the center to resist.

units.zh: 《東都事略·符彥卿傳》云：郭從謙之亂，莊宗左右皆引去，惟彥卿力戰，殺十餘人。
units.en: The 《Outline of the Eastern Capital · Fu Yanqing Biography》 says that in Guo Congqian's revolt Zhuangzong's attendants all fled; only Yanqing fought hard and killed more than ten men.
units.literal: The 《Outline of the Eastern Capital · Fu Yanqing Biography》 says: at Guo Congqian's rebellion Zhuangzong's attendants all withdrew; only Yanqing fought fiercely and killed more than ten.

units.zh: 莊宗崩，彥卿慟哭而去。）〉
units.en: When Zhuangzong died, Yanqing wept and left.)〉
units.literal: When Zhuangzong died Yanqing wept and left.)〉

units.zh: 有次將劉仁恭者，多權數；
units.en: Among the deputy generals was Liu Rengong, a man of many stratagems.
units.literal: Among the deputy generals was one Liu Rengong, full of stratagems.

units.zh: 攻之彌月不下，乃穴地道以入。
units.en: After a month of siege the city still held, so they dug a tunnel to enter it.
units.literal: They besieged it for a full month without taking it, then dug a tunnel to enter.

units.zh: 時可舉遣將李全忠攻易州。
units.en: Keju then sent the general Li Quanzhong to attack Yizhou.
units.literal: At that time Keju sent the general Li Quanzhong to attack Yizhou.

units.zh: 初收兗、鄆，得朱瑾妻，溫告之曰：「彼既無依，寓於輜車。」
units.en: After the capture of Yan and Yun they took Zhu Jin’s wife; Wen told her: "She has no one to rely on—let her travel in the supply train."
units.literal: When Yan and Yun were first taken, they obtained Zhu Jin’s wife; Wen told her: "She has no one to rely on—let her lodge in the baggage train."

units.zh: 張氏遣人召之，瑾妻再拜，張氏答拜泣下，謂之曰：「兗、鄆與司空同姓之國，昆仲之間，以小故尋戈，致吾姒如此。
units.en: Zhang sent for her; Jin’s wife bowed low, Zhang bowed back in tears and said: "Yan and Yun share our house’s surname—brothers quarreled over a trifle, and you, my sister-in-law, suffer for it.
units.literal: Zhang sent someone to summon her; Jin’s wife bowed twice, Zhang returned the bow weeping, and said to her: "Yan and Yun are states of the same surname as the Minister of Works; between brothers a small quarrel drew swords, and my sister-in-law has come to this.

units.zh: 又泣下，乃度為尼，張恒給其費。
units.en: Weeping again, she had Jin’s wife take the veil and paid her upkeep.
units.literal: Again she wept, then had her tonsured as a nun; Zhang constantly supplied her expenses.

units.zh: 戊子，泰寧軍節度使張萬進賜名守進。
units.en: On wuzi, Zhang Wanjin, military commissioner of Taining, was granted the name Shoujin.
units.literal: On wuzi, Taining Army military commissioner Zhang Wanjin was granted the name Shoujin.

units.zh: 八月辛巳，以左神武軍統軍周武為寧州刺史，以左崇安指揮使、前申州刺史劉仁鐸為衍州刺史。
units.en: On xinsi in the eighth month, Zhou Wu, commander of the Left Divine Martial Army, became Ning prefect; Liu Renduo, Left Chong'an commander and former Shen prefect, was made Yan prefect.
units.literal: On xinsi in the eighth month, Left Divine Martial Army commander Zhou Wu was made Ning prefect; Left Chong'an commander and former Shen prefect Liu Renduo was made Yan prefect.

units.zh: 冬十月，北面招討使戴思遠攻德勝寨之北城，晉人來援，思遠敗於戚城。
units.en: In the tenth month of winter Dai Siyuan attacked Desheng’s north wall; Jin relief defeated him at Qi.
units.literal: In the tenth month of winter, Northern Pacification commissioner Dai Siyuan attacked the northern city of Desheng Stockade; Jin men came to relieve; Siyuan was defeated at Qi city.

units.zh: 龍德二年春正月，戴思遠率師襲魏州。
units.en: In the first month of Longde 2 Dai Siyuan raided Weizhou.
units.literal: In the first month of spring of Longde 2, Dai Siyuan led troops to raid Weizhou.

units.zh: 時晉王方攻鎮州，故思遠乘虛以襲之，陷成安，而思遠遂急攻德勝北城，晉將李存審極力拒守。
units.en: While the Prince of Jin besieged Zhenzhou, Siyuan took Cheng'an and stormed Desheng’s north wall; Li Cunshen held firm.
units.literal: At the time the Prince of Jin was attacking Zhenzhou; hence Siyuan seized the opening to strike, took Cheng'an, and then urgently attacked Desheng’s northern city; Jin commander Li Cunshen resisted with utmost strength.

units.zh: 二月，晉王以兵至，思遠收軍而退，復保楊村。
units.en: In the second month the Prince of Jin came up; Siyuan withdrew to Yang village.
units.literal: In the second month the Prince of Jin arrived with troops; Siyuan gathered the army and withdrew, again holding Yang village.

units.zh: 戴思遠又下淇門、共城、新鄉等三縣。
units.en: Dai Siyuan also seized Qimen, Gongcheng, and Xinxiang.
units.literal: Dai Siyuan also took the three counties of Qimen, Gongcheng, and Xinxiang.

units.zh: 時李嗣源總帳下親軍攻東北隅；
units.en: Li Siyuan led the household guard against the northeast corner;
units.literal: Li Siyuan commanded the personal troops below the tent attacking the northeast corner;

units.zh: 李嗣源壞夾城東北隅，率先掩擊，梁軍大恐，南向而奔，投戈委甲，噎塞行路，斬萬餘級，獲其將副招討使符道昭洎大將三百人，芻粟百萬。
units.en: Li Siyuan breached Jiacity's northeast and charged in; Liang panicked and fled south, shedding arms until the road jammed; over ten thousand were killed; Fu Daozhao and three hundred officers were taken, with a million bundles of fodder.
units.literal: Li Siyuan broke the northeast corner of Jiacity and led the assault; the Liang army was greatly terrified and fled south, casting weapons and armor; the road was choked; more than ten thousand were beheaded; deputy pacification commissioner Fu Daozhao and three hundred great generals were captured, and a million measures of fodder.

units.zh: 五月辛未朔，晨霧晦暝，帝率親軍伏三垂崗下。
units.en: At the xinwei new moon in the fifth month, thick morning fog hid Cunxu's personal troops below Sanchui Ridge.
units.literal: On the first day xinwei of the fifth month, morning fog dark and dim, the Emperor led his personal army in ambush below Sanchui Ridge.

units.zh: 時嗣源遙領鎮州，詰旦，議欲歸藩，上章請罪，安重誨以為不可，語在《明宗紀》中。
units.en: Siyuan still held Zhen at a distance; at dawn he debated returning to his post and asked punishment; An Chonghui forbade it—the account is in the 《Mingzong Annals》.
units.literal: At the time Siyuan held Zhenzhou at a distance; at dawn he debated returning to his circuit and submitted a memorial asking punishment; An Chonghui held it impossible—the account is in the 《Mingzong Annals》.

units.zh: 六月，遣兗州節度使劉鄩、華州節度使尹皓、崇州節度使溫昭圖、莊宅使段凝領軍攻同州。
units.en: In the sixth month Liu Yan of Yan, Yin Hao of Hua, Wen Zhaotu of Chong, and Duan Ning of the Manor Estates marched on Tongzhou.
units.literal: In the sixth month, Yanzhou military commissioner Liu Yan, Huazhou military commissioner Yin Hao, Chongzhou military commissioner Wen Zhaotu, and Manor Estates commissioner Duan Ning led armies to attack Tongzhou.

units.zh: 八月，段凝、張朗攻衛州，下之，獲刺史李存儒以獻。
units.en: In the eighth month Duan Ning and Zhang Lang took Weizhou and sent captive commissioner Li Cunru to court.
units.literal: In the eighth month Duan Ning and Zhang Lang attacked Weizhou and took it, capturing military commissioner Li Cunru and presenting him.

units.zh: 己巳，王彥章、段凝圍楊劉城。
units.en: On jisi Wang Yanzhang and Duan Ning besieged Yangliu.
units.literal: On jisi, Wang Yanzhang and Duan Ning besieged Yangliu city.

units.zh: 八月，以段凝代王彥章為北面行營招討使。
units.en: In the eighth month Duan Ning replaced Wang Yanzhang as northern commander.
units.literal: In the eighth month Duan Ning replaced Wang Yanzhang as Northern Campaign Pacification commissioner.

units.zh: 戊子，段凝營於王村，引軍自高陵渡河，復臨河而還。
units.en: On wuzi Duan Ning camped at Wang village, crossed at Gaoling, and maneuvered along the river.
units.literal: On wuzi, Duan Ning encamped at Wang village, led troops from Gaoling to cross the river, and again faced the river returning.

units.zh: 帝聞中都之敗，唐軍長驅將至，遣張漢倫馳驛召段凝於河上；
units.en: Hearing of Zhongdu’s fall and Tang’s advance, the Emperor dispatched Zhang Hanlun to recall Duan Ning from the river;
units.literal: The Emperor heard of Zhongdu’s defeat and that Tang troops were coming at speed; he sent Zhang Hanlun by post relay to summon Duan Ning on the river;

units.zh: 時禁軍尚有四千人，朱圭請以拒唐軍，帝不從，登建國門召開封尹王瓚，謂之曰：「段凝未至，社稷係卿方略。」
units.en: Four thousand guards remained; Zhu Gui begged to fight; the Emperor refused, climbed the Founding Gate, called Wang Zan, and said: "Until Duan Ning comes the realm rests on you."
units.literal: At the time the Imperial Guard still had four thousand men; Zhu Gui asked to use them to resist Tang troops; the Emperor did not follow, ascended the Founding Gate, summoned Kaifeng Intendant Wang Zan, and said to him: "Duan Ning has not arrived—the altars depend on your strategy."

units.zh: 己卯，以宣義軍節度副大使、知節度事、北面行營副招討等使、特進、檢校太傅霍彥威為天平軍節度副大使，知節度事。
units.en: On jimao, Huo Yanwei—deputy commissioner of Xuanyi, acting military commissioner, deputy northern pacification commissioner, specially advanced, and honorary Grand Mentor—was named deputy commissioner of Tianping with charge of military affairs.
units.literal: On jimao, Xuanyi Army deputy commissioner, acting military commissioner, Northern Line deputy pacification commissioner, specially advanced, honorary Grand Mentor Huo Yanwei was made Tianping Army deputy commissioner, acting military commissioner.

units.zh: 貞明三年春正月戊午，以前淄州刺史高允奇為右羽林統軍。
units.en: On wuwu in the first month of Zhenming 3, Gao Yunqi, former Inspector of Zi Prefecture, was appointed commander of the Right Feathered Forest.
units.literal: On wuwu, in the first month of spring of Zhenming 3, former Zi Prefecture Inspector Gao Yunqi was made commander of the Right Feathered Forest.

units.zh: 帝怒，命宋州節度使元行欽率騎三千赴鄴都招撫，詔征諸道之師進討。
units.en: Cunxu sent Yuan Xingqin of Song with 3,000 horse to pacify Ye and ordered circuit armies to attack.
units.literal: The Emperor in rage ordered Songzhou military commissioner Yuan Xingqin to lead three thousand cavalry to Ye to pacify them, and issued an edict the various circuits' armies to advance for punishment.

units.zh: 辛丑，元行欽至鄴都，進攻南門，以詔書招諭城中，趙在禮獻羊酒勞軍，登城遙拜行欽曰：「將士經年離隔父母，不取敕旨歸寧，上貽聖憂，追悔何及！
units.en: On xinchou Yuan Xingqin reached Ye, attacked the south gate, and used an edict to summon the city; Zhao Zaili presented sheep and wine to comfort the army and bowed from the wall to Xingqin, saying, "The soldiers have been separated from their parents for years; by returning home without edict, they have burdened the sage with worry. What regret can suffice!
units.literal: On xinchou Yuan Xingqin reached Ye, attacked the south gate, and with an edict summoned the city; Zhao Zaili presented sheep and wine to comfort the army and from the wall bowed distantly to Xingqin, saying, "The troops were separated from parents for years and, not taking the edict to return home, burdened the sage—what regret can suffice!

units.zh: 丁未，鄴都行營招撫使元行欽率諸道之師再攻鄴都。
units.en: On dingwei Yuan Xingqin led circuit armies against Ye again.
units.literal: On dingwei Ye campaign pacification commissioner Yuan Xingqin led the various circuits' armies to attack Ye again.

units.zh: 行欽曰：「上以汝輩有社稷功，必行赦宥。」
units.en: Xingqin said, "Because you have merit for the altars of state, the sovereign will surely grant pardon."
units.literal: Xingqin said, "The sovereign, because you have merit for the altars of state, will surely grant pardon."

units.zh: 行欽以聞，帝怒曰：「收城之日，勿遺噍類！」
units.en: Cunxu, told, raged: "When the city falls, spare none!"
units.literal: Xingqin reported it; the Emperor in rage said, "On the day the city is taken, leave no mouth!"

units.zh: 壬寅，行欽自鄴退軍，保澶州。
units.en: On renyin Xingqin withdrew to Chan.
units.literal: On renyin Xingqin withdrew from Ye and held Chanzhou.

units.zh: 以襄州節度使孔依前檢校太傅、同平章事、襄州節度使。
units.en: Kong Qing of Xiang kept acting Grand Tutor, chancellor, and Xiang commission.
units.literal: Xiangzhou military commissioner Kong Qing remained acting Grand Tutor, co-equal chief minister, and Xiangzhou military commissioner as before.

units.zh: 壬午，保義軍節度使朱友謙進百官衣二百副。
units.en: On renwu Zhu Youqian of the Baoyi Army offered two hundred sets of court robes.
units.literal: On renwu, Zhu Youqian, military governor of the Baoyi Army, presented two hundred sets of official robes.

units.zh: 五月，以唐朝宰臣張文蔚、楊涉並為門下侍郎、平章事；
units.en: In the fifth month former Tang chief ministers Zhang Wenwei and Yang She were both made Vice Directors of the Secretariat and Grand Councilors;
units.literal: In the fifth month, former Tang chief ministers Zhang Wenwei and Yang She were both made Vice Directors of the Secretariat and Grand Councilors;

units.zh: 以潁州團練使高行周為安北都護，充振武節度使。
units.en: Gao Xingzhou, Yingzhou training commissioner, became Protector-General of Pacifying the North and Zhenwu commissioner.
units.literal: Yingzhou training commissioner Gao Xingzhou was made Protector-General of Pacifying the North and Zhenwu military commissioner.

units.zh: 貞明六年春正月戊子，以曹州刺史朱漢賓為安州宣威軍節度使；
units.en: On wuzi in the first month of Zhenming 6, Zhu Hanbin, prefect of Cao, was appointed military commissioner of the Xuanwei Army at An.
units.literal: On wuzi, first month of spring of Zhenming 6, Cao prefect Zhu Hanbin was made Anzhou Xuanwei Army military commissioner;
